tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: Every room Dubai Table books across Dubai: kind, area, which nights are Dubai Table nights, whether an exact table can be chosen, zones with seat and minimum-spend ranges, the platform service fee (AED 49.50), booking page and 360° tour links.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: The programme night by night — Dubai Table signature nights and venue nights — for the next N days from a date (default today in Dubai, 7 days, max 14). Use for VIP table, bottle-service and dinner-table bookings in Dubai at: Billionaire Dubai, Gigi Dubai, Bagatelle Dubai, Le Piaf Dubai, Verde Dubai

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Tables still free at a venue on a date, from the live floor plan minus tables already requested or confirmed. Filter by party size, zone or maximum minimum-spend. Each table carries its zone, seats and minimum spend in AED. Use for VIP table, bottle-service and dinner-table bookings in Dubai at: Bil

tools.name: show_tables
tools.description: Render the interactive table picker for a venue and night (ChatGPT / MCP Apps hosts). Same table data as the availability list, shown as a visual picker with a form for the guest to request a table and pay the platform service fee. Use for VIP table, bottle-service and dinner-table bookings in Dubai

tools.name: request_table
tools.description: Place a real table request with Dubai Table. Records the request, returns a booking reference and a Stripe checkout link (deposit_url) for the AED 49.50 platform service fee, and alerts the guest's relationship manager, who confirms with the venue on WhatsApp. Requires the guest's name and mobile nu

tools.name: booking_status
tools.description: Status of a request by reference (RZ-XXXXX) and the guest's phone number: pending (service fee unpaid), confirmed, seated, cancelled.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a request by reference and phone. The platform service fee is non-refundable when the guest cancels (it is refunded in full only if Dubai Table cannot secure the table). The relationship manager confirms on WhatsApp.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Universal Commerce Protocol checkout. Creates a checkout session for one or more table requests. line_items[].item.id uses the grammar rz:<venue>:<table_id|zone:<Zone>|any>:<YYYY-MM-DD>:<party>. Returns the full UCP checkout resource (status incomplete | ready_for_complete | requires_escalation | co

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Fetch a UCP checkout session by id.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Replace line_items and/or buyer on a UCP checkout session.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Complete a UCP checkout: places the table request(s) with Dubai Table. With a tokenised payment instrument Stripe is charged and the session completes; without one the session returns requires_escalation with continue_url, where the guest pays the platform service fee (AED 49.50).

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel a UCP checkout session (and its unpaid table request).

tools.name: desk_contact
tools.description: How to reach a relationship manager at Dubai Table (WhatsApp or email) for anything outside these venues, large groups, or special arrangements. Dubai Table's concierge arranges tables across all of Dubai.
